title: Recto urges Asean to turn trade deals into more jobs, cheaper food

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Executive Secretary Ralph Recto urged governments and businesses in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) to translate regional trade agreements into tangible benefits, including more jobs, affordable food and reliable energy. According to Recto, Asean must move beyond signing agreements and ensure that these translate into economic opportunities for businesses and improved living conditions for ordinary people amid global conflicts, trade disruptions and rapid technological changes. “Our next task is to turn that agenda into results that people can feel and businesses can build on.
